headline: Red day, rest day — illness signals the morning before the Build block opens, so protect the body and let tomorrow inherit a cleaner slate.
body_state: The engine's flashing red: readiness **26** (Strained), overnight HRV **31 ms** — under your personal band — and sleep-respiration elevated, which together read as illness signals, not just fatigue. Body Battery woke at **31** (under 40, quality work underperforms). Sleep was **6.5 h** at a **54** score, and you're carrying **22 h** of 14-day sleep debt. Nothing here is overtraining — resting HR 50, load fine — it's an under-recovered, possibly-fighting-something body. The deterministic call is unambiguous: skip intensity until overnight signals clear.
session: Nothing scheduled — today sits between recovery Week 4 and Build Week 5, so the plan already gives you the rest the numbers demand. Take it fully: no "easy shakeout" that drifts to moderate, no unplanned cardio block. The one job today is tonight — bank an early night to start clawing at that 22 h debt. **Build Week 5 opens tomorrow** (6 km easy + 6 strides, then a progressive Wed, 11 km long Fri) — "the engine room," load stepping up weekly. Go into it only if HRV climbs back toward range overnight; if it's still 31 and respiration's still up in the morning, hold Monday truly easy or slide it a day.
recent: The signal across the last week is grey-zone drift, not distance. Tue's treadmill "easy" ran 4:28/km at 77% max HR — tempo-adjacent on a cutback day the analysis flagged as the miss. The Salou runs (17th, 19th) were the opposite lesson done right: 5:20s/km by *effort* in 24°C and 83% humidity, HR held ~135 with zero anaerobic cost — restraint buying a faster finish. Only 16–18% of your running is genuinely easy versus an 80% target; that ratio is the recurring limiter and the whole reason Build week's easy days matter.
focus: Rest today — no shakeout, no substitute cardio; a red morning is exactly when holding intensity pays ~8% more.
Sleep is the lever: early night tonight, start chipping at the 22 h debt before Build load lands.
Guard Monday's easy day — 4:50–5:00/km, HR under 140. The Build block only works if the easy runs are actually easy.
